text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Meisho 
Doto, a certain poster caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... "Shopping District Karaoke 
Contest"... T-There's an event like this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! Wait, but but but! It says entries 
are closed right there!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-Besides... with my singing... there's no 
way it's good enough for the 
competition... Hauu~.
choice_data_list:
If it's your song, I'm sure it'll be just 
fine!

With your singing, everything's sure to be 
alright!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Hawawawa~!? I-It's so 
embarrassinggg~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
......B-But... this is a ch-chance to see 
the results of our training... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: M-Maybe I should enter...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to give entering the 
Karaoke Contest a shot, figuring there was 
nothing to lose, but—

text_block_list.name: Tournament Organizer
text_block_list.text:
A walk-in, huh... Hmmm, that's a bit of a 
problem. We can't prepare the music right 
away either...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, I'm really no good at all... I 
don't have any confidence... and I just 
mope around...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Still, so many people praised my 
singing. S-Singing by someone like me...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"S-So I want lots of people to hear it... 
and look forward just a little bit...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what am I saying?! I-I'm so 
sorry! Blabbering on like that!"
choice_data_list: Let me ask as well, please!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fueh... T-Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Tournament Organizer
text_block_list.text:
I see... I understand your feelings! If 
you don't mind performing a cappella, 
you're free to participate.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-A-Are you sure, really!? Waaaah, thank 
you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Um, if I were on my own, I 
n-never would have been able to stand on 
stage...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Urara-san, 
Shakur-san... and Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-It is a little scary, but! I-I'll... do 
my absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Meisho Doto headed toward the 
stage for the karaoke contest.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, ummm... M-Meisho Doto! Will now si—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fubah... !?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chatter chatter chatter chatter...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueh... I-I'm sorry. Meisho Doto... w-will 
shing now!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Whoa, are you all right...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: *deep breath*... *exhale*.........!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A silhouette in the wharf sky~~♪ Looking 
just like you, a tear gently falls~~♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing not if it's love, knowing not if 
it's affection, I am all alone—"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
...! That really... hits you right in the 
feels...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone realized it, everyone was 
listening in silence. It seemed Meisho 
Doto's song had completely captivated the 
audience's hearts...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaaauuunnngh~~! You will neeeever... 
retuuurn... againnn~~♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Little lady! That was an amazing song!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa~~...! T-To get applause like 
that...?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Th-... Thank you all so much for 
listening!
choice_data_list: Victory is as good as ours.
Victory is as good as ours, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Th-... Thank you all so much for 
listening!
choice_data_list: Victory is as good as ours.
Victory is as good as ours, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Encore! Encore!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueh!? Trainer-san... and e-e-e-everyone 
else too...!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-then... if my singing is al-alright...! 
I-I'll shing my very best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto sang in response to the 
encore. She looked just a little prouder 
than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh...!? S-Someone like me still has so, 
so far to gooo...!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Man, you've got a truly wonderful voice! 
You absolutely have to enter the next 
tournament too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyowa?! A-A-Are you sure I can 
participate?! Um, um... I look forward to 
working with youuu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her singing voice, Meisho Doto 
successfully secured an entry for the next 
karaoke contest!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
First place...?! N-No way, impossible, 
impossibleee...! There are so, so many 
people way better than meee~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Hell no! We're rooting for you, missy!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeeh?! E-E-Everyone?! S-Someone like 
me... like me... Awa-wa-wa-wa~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The winner was chosen from the officially 
registered contestants. However, Meisho 
Doto, who joined on the fly, won over the 
crowd and received a special award!
